step1.title: Paso 1
step1.heading: Describe Your Business
step1.description: Tell us about the services you offer so clients can find you easily.
step1.uploadPrompt: Upload your business logo or profile picture.
step1.businessDescriptionPlaceholder: Example: Reliable plumbing services with 10+ years of experience. Free estimates!
step1.businessDescriptionTooltip: Pro tip: Mention what makes you unique! Example: 'Certified electrician serving Zone 10 since 2015'

step2.title: Step 2
step2.heading: What’s your expertise?
step2.description: Choose all the categories where your business stands out. You can choose more than one! 💡

step3.title: Step 3
step3.heading: Where do you work?
step3.invalidCity: Oops! This city isn’t in our system 🌎
step3.description: Add your business address and mark the areas you serve.
step3.selectAnotherDepartment: Do you work in other departments?

step4.title: Step 4
step4.heading: Want more clients? 💼
step4.description: List every service you master — the more you add, the more jobs you get.
step4.descriptionTextField: E.g.: '10+ years fixing leaks in downtown. Written guarantee!'

step5.title: Step 5 |
step5.subtitle: Almost there!
step5.heading: What’s your daily rate? 💰
step5.description: Set your approximate daily rate. Don’t worry, you can adjust it later for each job.
step5.note: 💡 Reminder: This is just an estimate. You’ll agree on the final price with the client.

step6.heading: Congratulations!
step6.description: ¡Your profile is now public! Get ready to connect with clients who value real skills.
step6.tip: Your profile will be visible in less than 24 hours (but usually within 1 hour) ⏱️
